hints.title: Carry Lookahead
hints.text: When doubling a single decimal digit, a carry of one occurs if and only if the digit is five or greater.

hints.title: Leading Node Insertion
hints.text: If the head node value is five or greater, a new node with value one must be prepended as the new head.

hints.title: Single Pass Mutation
hints.text: For each node, compute (node.val * 2 + (1 if next_node and next_node.val >= 5 else 0)) modulo 10.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Single pass traversal using forward carry lookahead.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversing the list twice takes extra passes when forward lookahead achieves the same in one pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond optionally prepending one leading node.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that carries can only ever be 0 or 1, predictable purely by the immediate next digit.

solutions.approach: Forward Carry Lookahead Single Pass Mutation
